Name: Berechiah, Son of Meshillemoth
Summary: Berechiah, son of Meshillemoth, was one of the heads of Ephraim who stood up against bringing Judah's captives into Samaria.
KeyStory: Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth stood with the other heads against the returning host.
LifeLesson: Four heads together stopped a city from adding sin to sin.
